context: Implemented worktree-aware .twining root resolution (server 2.3.0-pending + plugin 1.20.0): resolveWorktreeMain in src/utils/project-root.ts redirects the cwd-default root to the main checkout when .git is a gitdir: worktree pointer (submodules excluded, TWINING_WORKTREE_LOCAL=true opt-out, --project/TWINING_PROJECT never redirected); byte-identical mirrored block in all five plugin hooks, which now also honor TWINING_PROJECT; pre-commit hook gained walk-up detection and its hard-coded sentinel path was fixed to $TWINING_DIR. Fixes the cmux claude-teams --worktree store-divergence finding 01KY66434W.
rationale: .last-record is a global timestamp sentinel, so same-directory multi-session teams already share gate state; worktree sharing adopts those identical pre-existing semantics rather than inventing new ones.
summary: Chose shared-store-by-default for linked worktrees with the gate-semantics rationale settled by evidence
